reference_sql:
SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id AND p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY c.parent_category
alternatives: SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id AND p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1

SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(CASE WHEN p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_products FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.parent_category

other_way.sql: SELECT c.parent_category, SUM(CASE WHEN p.launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_products FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.parent_category
other_way.tradeoff: A CASE inside SUM can test the launch year after a plain LEFT JOIN, but the test in ON keeps the count simpler.

FROM categories c
